Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses multiple proteomics approaches: a SILAC-based global proteome screen and LFQ-based peptide pull-downs. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'Top-down proteomics' in experimentTypes, the Methods section explicitly describes tryptic digestion (Bottom-up) and the use of DDA (top-10/top-20). The primary focus is on methylation PTMs, but no specific enrichment antibodies for methylation (like those for phospho or ubiquitin) were used for the global screen; instead, they relied on 'brute force' high-resolution MS.

scope: For analysis of the methylation status of eEF1A1 and eEF1A2, the above-described stable cell lines for inducible overexpression of 3×-FLAG-tagged eEF1A proteins were used.
The supernatant after ultra-centrifugation was incubated by head-over-tail rotation for 2 h at 4 °C with anti-FLAG M2 agarose beads (Sigma).
The beads were collected by centrifugation using Corning FiltrEX filter plates (Sigma) and washed twice with 200 μl 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5) and 100 mM NaCl.
